title: ORRERY — a small universe
description: An atmospheric, keyboard-accessible planetary-system toy with a procedural Three.js scene, planet dossiers, play/pause, simulation speed, reset, and drag-orbit/scroll-zoom controls. All scene textures and stars are generated locally.

tests.name: Local Vite bundle (write:false, harness-equivalent configuration)
tests.command: Vite build API with configFile:false, run directory as root, lib entry main.js, inlineDynamicImports:true, minify:true, write:false
tests.outcome: passed; outputs were runtime.iife.js (chunk) and runtime.css (asset); no non-CSS assets

tests.name: Required module script marker
tests.command: Checked index.html for exact <script type="module" src="./main.js"></script> marker

repairsMade: Removed an empty CSS @import so the page has no unnecessary external-resource reference.
knownLimitations: Stylized orbital motion, distances, and sizes are not scientifically to scale.
Interactive 3D rendering requires WebGL; a labelled fallback remains visible if renderer initialization fails.
Browser verification was not performed because local browser access is unavailable in this environment.
